shortDescription: Perform common tasks in Nagios related to downtime and notifications

options.name: action
options.description: Action to take. The V(acknowledge) and V(forced_check) actions were added in community.general 1.2.0.

options.name: author
options.description: Author to leave downtime comments as. Only used when O(action) is V(downtime) or V(acknowledge).

options.name: cmdfile
options.description: Path to the nagios I(command file) (FIFO pipe). Only required if auto-detection fails.

options.name: command
options.description: The raw command to send to Nagios, which should not include the submitted time header or the line-feed. B(Required) option when O(action=command).

options.name: comment
options.description: Comment when O(action) is V(downtime) or V(acknowledge).

options.name: host
options.description: Host to operate on in Nagios.

options.name: minutes
options.description: Minutes to schedule downtime for. Only usable with O(action=downtime).

options.name: servicegroup
options.description: The Servicegroup we want to set downtimes/alerts for. B(Required) option when using the V(servicegroup_service_downtime) and V(servicegroup_host_downtime) O(action).

options.name: services
options.description: What to manage downtime/alerts for. Separate multiple services with commas. B(Required) option when O(action) is one of: V(downtime), V(acknowledge), V(forced_check), V(enable_alerts), V(disable_alerts). When specifying what O(services) to handle there is a special service value, V(host), which handles alerts/downtime/acknowledge for the I(host itself), for example O(services=host). options.name: start
options.description: When downtime should start, in C(time_t) format (epoch seconds).
